card.fires_on: Responds to the middle piece of a capitalized surname or ethnic name split into parts, right after an initial like L, Lan, Lin, Wenz or Con. Examples are Lenz, Lanzer, Linnaeus and Lapps.

modes.label: Surname after L
modes.description: Second piece of a surname that starts with L, such as Lenz, Lanzer, Lapp or Laffaye.
